2105-3603-8201-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-8201-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-8201-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

769-2034-6264.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
769-2034-6264.description:
During your cleanup step, discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, creating a number of tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens equal to the number of cards you discarded.
When the Zombie(s) enter, Mentor of the Meek triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Mentor of the Meek trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Resolve all remaining Mentor of the Meek triggers, as applicable, choosing not to pay.
As it's still your cleanup step, you will again discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.
769-2034-6264.notes: Step 4 can be skipped if you have mana leftover from the previous iteration.

3457-4880-7791.description:
Activate Weaver of Currents by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Weaver of Currents.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Weaver of Currents.
Repeat.

206-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4064-4872-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Abuelo.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

206-1270-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

4559-5686-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
4559-5686-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5686-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

204-1858-2056-2633-7292.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-7292.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7235.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

628-2292-7216.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

628-6797-7187.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4288-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4288-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1939-2919-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-2919-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Repeat from step 2.

2178-4026-4050-6990.description:
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Michelangelo from your hand to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Michelangelo, adding {G}.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Elvish Piper trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elvish Piper trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

4215-5630-5686-6872.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4498-5779.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
4498-5779.description:
During any turn, activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Each creature your opponents control dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat each turn as desired.
4498-5779.notes: This lock can be repeated multiple times during a single turn if you have mana available. However, this damage also stacks on your creatures - and if Maha dies then the lock ends. This lock will also destroy any creatures you control with toughness 1. As it does 1 damage to each player every time you activate it, you must stop once your life total hits 1.

1308-5658-6245-6753.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
1308-5658-6245-6753.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
1308-5658-6245-6753.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1434-2500-3609--121.easyPrerequisites: Creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
1434-2500-3609--121.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of the Spacecraft until end of turn
Activate Mirage Mirror by tapping a creature with power 3 or greater, putting at least three charge counters on it.
During your next turn, activate Mirage Mirror twice by paying {4}, with the first ability targeting the Spacecraft and the second ability targeting Magistrate's Scepter.
Resolve the first ability, causing Mirage Mirror to become a copy of Magistrate's Scepter until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Mirage Mirror's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Mirage Mirror ability from step 3, causing it to become a copy of the Spacecraft until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
1434-2500-3609--121.notes: If the creature(s) tapped has power 4 or greater, you may be able to bypass causing Mirage Mirror to become a copy of the Spacecraft. This can be done as long as Mirage Mirror has six or more charge counters on it before starting step 3.

643-2060-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}
Repeat.
643-2060-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Crystalline Crawler for additional mana.

1305-1849-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

1251-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

224-907-1772-6664.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1874-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1874-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

345-411-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
345-411-4103-4613.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

407-2196-2821-5803.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
407-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Swamps.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
407-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate another land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Cabal Coffers and another land.
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate another land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 5.

2092-4499-5422.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-4499-5422.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking The Third Doctor.
When The Third Doctor enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

586-2510-2921-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2510-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

586-2520-3036-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Priest of Gix from your hand onto the battlefield and giving it haste.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Skyshroud Elf's second ability twice by paying {2}, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Wizard Mentor from your hand onto the battlefield and giving it haste.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

628-997-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-997-5490.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

78-2226-2397.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
78-2226-2397.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{G}{W}.
78-2226-2397.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Steel Leaf Paladin by paying {4}{G}{W}.
When Steel Leaf Paladin enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's other abilities.

3008-3048-4186-5296.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3008-3048-4186-5296.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak and Workhorse.
Scurry Oak triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Workhorse twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1274-4490.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1274-4490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

At the beginning of your end step, Westvale Cult Leader triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.

950-3201-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
950-3201-4222.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
